question: On netdisk-pan/lz-qaiu-top-netdisk-fast-download-keyless-multi-pan-dire, does the free keyless hosted instance resolve Quark and UC shares? The current README places Quark and UC in the open-source build and reserves full Baidu and Xunlei support for the professional endpoint, but the record is measured and its notes still put Quark and UC in the keyed tier.
why: A first-page read settles only the documented rung, which cannot override or lower a measured record. Settling the free/keyed split at the record's rung needs a measured probe of a keyless Quark and UC resolve against the hosted instance; no public Quark or UC share token is available in this scope.
